note: Test vectors only. The RSA key is generated for these vectors and protects nothing. Change only together with the bootstrap protocol.
method: Request: compact JWE alg RSA-OAEP enc A256GCM under the server key, plaintext is the exact text of request.plaintext. Response: compact JWE alg dir enc A256GCM under responseKey. requestDigest = SHA256 hex of JSON of the request plaintext without issuedAt, keys sorted at the top level. JWE are not deterministic: each token decrypts to its plaintext, both directions are checked.
